needed.evidence: informal use of the path, partly blocked footway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk on the right side with adequate width and safety barriers to prevent encroachment by informal paths and parked vehicles.

needed.evidence: people crossing the carriageway without any crossing facility or zebra crossing
needed.suggestion: Implement a pedestrian crossing facility with signalisation or marked zebra crossing to improve pedestrian safety at this high-demand crossing point.
Add a refuge island in the middle of the wide road to provide a safe waiting space for pedestrians crossing.

needed.suggestion: Install bollards or barriers at regular intervals along the sidewalk to prevent encroachment by parked motorbikes and vendors.
